ELENA MARCHETTI

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Operations executive with 24 years in healthcare services, 12 at the VP level or above. Built and
ran operations for networks of 40 to 110 outpatient sites. Known for turning around underperforming
regions, standing up shared services, and developing leaders who now run their own P&Ls.
